Market today: Inflation is the bogeyman, driving yields up and hitting growth names. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, is feeling this pinch.

Your holdings: SMCI (-16.6%), MUU (-26.15%), SOXL (-49.33%), and SPAL (-30.7%) are all marked SELL and are bleeding. SMH (-10.42%) is TRIM and also down. These leveraged and chip names are the main concern.

Watch: Keep an eye on SOXS. It's a bearish ETF and could be a hedge if the chip sell-off continues.

Bottom line: The inflation data is the primary driver, and your leveraged tech holdings are the most vulnerable.
plays: Trim SMCI and MUU: These are marked SELL and are down significantly. Consider reducing exposure.
Consider SOXS: If the chip sell-off accelerates, SOXS is a potential short-term hedge. Entry 40.49-40.38, stop 39.66.
No new buys today - hold and watch
